task: Write a function that parses an AWS ARN (Amazon Resource Name) and returns a dictionary containing the partition, service, region, account-id, and resource components
solution_criteria: Function correctly splits ARN string on colons, handles ARNs with and without regions/account-ids, returns dict with keys: partition, service, region, account_id, resource

task: Create a CloudFormation template JSON that defines an S3 bucket with versioning enabled and server-side encryption using AES256
solution_criteria: Valid CloudFormation JSON with S3 bucket resource, VersioningConfiguration Status set to Enabled, BucketEncryption with SSEAlgorithm AES256

task: Write a regex pattern that validates AWS Security Group IDs (format: sg- followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters)
solution_criteria: Pattern matches sg-12345678 and sg-0123456789abcdef0 formats, anchored to match full string, only accepts valid hexadecimal characters, rejects invalid lengths
